paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training set.
model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots showing training rewards over steps for two different training sets: "Easy Training Set" and "Hard Training Set," each comparing two models: Llama-On-Policy (teal line) and Llama-LUFFY (red line). In both plots, the x-axis represents "Steps," ranging from 0 to 500 with linear spacing and tick marks every 100 steps. The y-axis represents "Training Rewards," with a linear scale; the top plot ranges from 0.0 to 0.4, and the bottom plot from 0.0 to 0.2. In the "Easy Training Set" plot, both models start at 0.0 reward and increase over steps. The red Llama-LUFFY-Easy line rises steadily, reaching approximately 0.38 by step 500, while the teal Llama-On-Policy-Easy line rises more gradually, peaking around 0.32 and then plateauing. Both lines are accompanied by shaded regions indicating uncertainty or standard deviation. In the "Hard Training Set" plot, the red Llama-LUFFY-Hard line also starts at 0.0 and increases, reaching about 0.18 by step 500 with noticeable fluctuations. The teal Llama-On-Policy-Hard line rises slightly at first, reaches approximately 0.03 by step 100, then drops to near 0.0 and remains flat for the rest of the steps. Both lines again have shaded uncertainty regions.
